Hi Jenny — great to meet you over email and thanks for the spreadsheet. Short answer: Redwood will own the SKU mapping and billing integration for the Marketplace listing, but procurement handoff typically involves a couple of coordinated steps between product, billing ops, and your procurement/legal teams.

I've attached a one-page Mutual Action Plan that lays out the standard handoff timeline and owners (we use this to avoid surprise billing delays). Key items we'll cover on the kickoff:

- SKU & pricing confirmation (owner: Redwood billing ops)
- Legal/contract signoff & DocuSign route (owner: Redwood legal + Acme legal)
- Co-sell enablement checklist (owner: Redwood partnerships)
- Test purchase & invoice verification (owner: Acme billing contact + Redwood finance)

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick intake call to confirm SKUs and required artifacts (30 min).
2) Redline SOW and prepare DocuSign envelope.
3) Finalize Marketplace listing metadata and schedule test purchase.

I can host the kickoff on Tue 2027-06-28 10:00 AM PT — invite attached below. If that doesn't work, send a couple alternative windows.

Attachments: GCP_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf

Best,
Soojin Lee
